title: Comprehensive Quality Audit Gates and Scoring Engine
description: Deterministic scoring engine requiring a minimum 90 percent composite score across five pedagogical and structural pillars.

pedagogical_rigor.criteria: Clear problem stakes, progressive complexity, 4-tier pedagogical cards present, senior mentor epiphanies

rule19_lexical_purity.criteria: Zero hyphens or dashes in all user prose, headings, dialogues, and callouts (0 violations = 10 pts, else 0 pts)

visual_comic_geometry.criteria: Inside-image balloons, top 25% negative headroom, zero face occlusion, <=120 character speech limits

technical_accuracy_and_code.criteria: 100% runnable code examples, zero undefined crashes, defensive error handling, test harness passes

character_and_world_continuity.criteria: Consistent attire, realistic dialogue voice, authentic Indian setting, cohesive narrative arc
